أَبْلَدٌ A man having a space clear from hair between his eyebrows: or having eyebrows not joined: i. q. أَبْلَجُ. (S, M.) ＝
-A2- [More, and most, stupid, dull, wanting in intelligence, or in penetration, sharpness, vigour, or effectiveness, in the performing of affairs: see بَلُدَ.] You say, أَبْلَدُ مِنْ ثَوْرٍ [More stupid, &c., than a bull]. (A.) ―
-b2- See also بَلِيدٌ. ―
-b3- A man (S) of large, (S, K,) big, gross, rude, or coarse, (M,) make. (S, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
